name: Feature request

---

<!--
Before writing: please check docs/RELEASE_v1.0.md "Post-launch
follow-ups" and the open issues — we may already be planning
the same thing.
-->

## What problem are you trying to solve

The use case that motivated this idea. What were you trying to
do when the gap became visible?

## What would the ideal solution look like

A short description of the change you want. If you have a
UI / API sketch, include it.

## Alternatives you've considered

What else have you tried? Why didn't those work?

## Provider scope

If the feature is provider-specific (AWS-only / Azure-only /
S3-family / etc.), list the providers it should cover.

## Pro vs Free

Bucketeer Pro is gated to four pillars (Mount as Drive, Sync
Engine, Cross-account copy, Menubar mode). Where would your
feature land? Free, Pro, or both?

## Anything else

Screenshots from competitors, prior art, API docs from your
provider, links to related discussions — anything that helps
us evaluate.
